long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: There is more clay at the bank, and I want a second piece to keep beside the first.
I will take one piece of clay with empty paws and carry it home.
The workbench is where clay gets shaped, and I have decided to try again.
I will shape the clay into something worth keeping, which is the point of my long goal.
From the lookout rock I can see the whole beach, and I prefer high places.
My energy is running low and a patch of sun is the right place to recover it.

today.reason: The lamp is already on the desk and I have nothing in my paws, so the old first step would be turned down; I will go straight for the clay.
